title: Connor's Utility Mod
description: More commands and pushing you up when stuck.
body:
Pushes you up when you're stuck and adds new commands. I made this mod in preparation for my upcoming mod. You'll see that when it's done. Aside from that, I hope you like this mod.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

`/fallingblock` - Summons a chosen falling block at a position.

</details>
